title: Prague Spring
text:
The Prague Spring was a period of political liberalization and mass protest in 
the Czechoslovak Socialist Republic. It began on 5 January 1968, when reformist Alexander Dubček was elected First Secretary of the Communist Party of Czechoslovakia (KSČ), and continued until 21 August 1968, when the Soviet Union and four other Warsaw Pact members invaded the country to suppress the reforms.
